classification: test-gate ordering defect; separate from observed upstream TLS clone failure
cause: claim() waited for a Ready workload before reading cloneStatus. CSI refuses attachment until cloning completes, so a native failed state spent the full client timeout instead of stopping at the failed prerequisite.
fix: After original PVC/PV/Volume binding, require native clone completed before creating the workload; fail immediately on failed clone state. The running qualification stays on its original frozen code until its owned exit.
boundary: No live fixed-runner qualification yet; current full static evidence predates this ordering fix. No upstream image change or TLS disablement.
